decision.observation: The farmer is southeast of the mailbox at 9:30 a.m. Saturday; shrubs block direct eastward travel, while the mailbox-level dirt path is clear farther north.
decision.hypothesis: Moving north onto that path will clear the shrubs and allow uninterrupted travel east toward the bus stop and Pelican Town.
decision.memory: Route to Willy: east past the mailbox through the bus stop; west of town take the southeast branch through the fountain square to the southern east–west road, then go east across the river before turning south. Avoid the wooded area directly south of town.
